rows.question: Please generate a summary of the closing balances at the end of each month for each customer transactions, show the monthly changes and monthly cumulative bank account balances. Ensure that even if a customer has no account activity in a given month, the balance for that month is still included in the output.

WITH customer_txn_monthly_rollup AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    CAST(strftime('%Y', date(txn_date)) AS INTEGER) AS year,
    CAST(strftime('%m', date(txn_date)) AS INTEGER) AS month,
    date(strftime('%Y-%m-01', date(txn_date))) AS month_start_date,
    date(strftime('%Y-%m-01', date(txn_date)), '+1 month', '-1 day') AS month_end_date,
    SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(txn_type) = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE 0 END) AS monthly_total_deposits,
    SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(txn_type) = 'deposit' THEN 0 ELSE txn_amount END) AS monthly_total_withdrawals,
    SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(txn_type) = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE -txn_amount END) AS monthly_net_change
  FROM customer_transactions
  GROUP BY customer_id, year, month
),
customer_month_ranges AS (
  -- find for each customer the min and max month bounds (as first-of-month dates)
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    MIN(month_start_date) AS min_month_start,
    MAX(month_start_date) AS max_month_start
  FROM customer_txn_monthly_rollup
  GROUP BY customer_id
),
nums AS (
  -- generate a sequence 0..599 (600 months ~50 years). Implemented without window functions.
  SELECT (a.i + 10*b.i + 100*c.i) AS n
  FROM
    (SELECT 0 i UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9) a,
    (SELECT 0 i UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9) b,
    (SELECT 0 i UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4) c  -- 10*10*5 = 500 (adjust as needed)
),
customer_month_sequence AS (
  -- expand each customer's month range using nums
  SELECT
    r.customer_id,
    date(r.min_month_start, '+' || n.n || ' months') AS month_start_date
  FROM customer_month_ranges r
  JOIN nums n
    ON date(r.min_month_start, '+' || n.n || ' months') <= r.max_month_start
),
customer_months AS (
  -- build final month rows per customer including month metadata
  SELECT
    cms.customer_id,
    CAST(strftime('%Y', cms.month_start_date) AS INTEGER) AS year,
    CAST(strftime('%m', cms.month_start_date) AS INTEGER) AS month,
    cms.month_start_date,
    date(cms.month_start_date, '+1 month', '-1 day') AS month_end_date
  FROM customer_month_sequence cms
),
monthly_with_defaults AS (
  -- left join rollup to include months without activity
  SELECT
    m.customer_id,
    m.year,
    m.month,
    m.month_start_date,
    m.month_end_date,
    COALESCE(r.monthly_total_deposits, 0) AS monthly_total_deposits,
    COALESCE(r.monthly_total_withdrawals, 0) AS monthly_total_withdrawals,
    COALESCE(r.monthly_net_change, 0) AS monthly_net_change
  FROM customer_months m
  LEFT JOIN customer_txn_monthly_rollup r
    ON r.customer_id = m.customer_id
    AND r.year = m.year
    AND r.month = m.month
)
SELECT
  customer_id,
  year,
  month,
  month_start_date,
  month_end_date,
  monthly_total_deposits,
  monthly_total_withdrawals,
  monthly_net_change,
  -- closing_balance: running sum of monthly_net_change per customer
  (
    SELECT SUM(m2.monthly_net_change)
    FROM monthly_with_defaults m2
    WHERE m2.customer_id = m1.customer_id
      AND (m2.year < m1.year OR (m2.year = m1.year AND m2.month <= m1.month))
  ) AS closing_balance,
  -- month_over_month_change: current closing - previous closing (previous default 0)
  (
    (SELECT SUM(m2.monthly_net_change)
     FROM monthly_with_defaults m2
     WHERE m2.customer_id = m1.customer_id
       AND (m2.year < m1.year OR (m2.year = m1.year AND m2.month <= m1.month))
    )
    -
    COALESCE(
      (SELECT SUM(m3.monthly_net_change)
       FROM monthly_with_defaults m3
       WHERE m3.customer_id = m1.customer_id
         AND (m3.year < m1.year OR (m3.year = m1.year AND m3.month <= m1.month - 1))
      ), 0)
  ) AS month_over_month_change,
  -- cumulative_balance same as closing_balance given starting balance zero
  (
    SELECT SUM(m2.monthly_net_change)
    FROM monthly_with_defaults m2
    WHERE m2.customer_id = m1.customer_id
      AND (m2.year < m1.year OR (m2.year = m1.year AND m2.month <= m1.month))
  ) AS cumulative_balance
FROM monthly_with_defaults m1
ORDER BY customer_id, year, month

  SELECT DISTINCT customer_id
  FROM customer_transactions
  WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL
),
txns AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    txn_date AS txn_date_iso,
    LOWER(txn_type) AS txn_type_lc,
    txn_amount,
    customer_id AS cid
  FROM customer_transactions
  WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL
    AND txn_amount IS NOT NULL
    AND txn_date IS NOT NULL

-- restrict to rows where the year is 2020 by checking the first 4 chars = '2020'
txns_2020 AS (
  SELECT
    cid AS customer_id,
    date(txn_date_iso) AS txn_date,
    txn_amount,
    CASE
      WHEN txn_type_lc = 'deposit' THEN 'deposit'
      WHEN txn_type_lc = 'withdrawal' THEN 'withdrawal'
      ELSE txn_type_lc
    END AS txn_type
  FROM txns
  WHERE substr(txn_date_iso,1,4) = '2020'
),
monthly_balances AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    substr(txn_date,1,7) AS month_yyyy_mm,
    SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount WHEN txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN -txn_amount ELSE 0 END) AS month_balance
  FROM txns_2020
  GROUP BY customer_id, substr(txn_date,1,7)
),
months AS (
  SELECT '2020-01' AS month_yyyy_mm UNION ALL
  SELECT '2020-02' UNION ALL
  SELECT '2020-03' UNION ALL
  SELECT '2020-04' UNION ALL
  SELECT '2020-05' UNION ALL
  SELECT '2020-06' UNION ALL
  SELECT '2020-07' UNION ALL
  SELECT '2020-08' UNION ALL
  SELECT '2020-09' UNION ALL
  SELECT '2020-10' UNION ALL
  SELECT '2020-11' UNION ALL
  SELECT '2020-12'
),
customer_month_matrix AS (
  SELECT m.month_yyyy_mm, c.customer_id,
         COALESCE(b.month_balance, 0) AS month_balance
  FROM months m
  CROSS JOIN distinct_customers c
  LEFT JOIN monthly_balances b
    ON b.customer_id = c.customer_id
   AND b.month_yyyy_mm = m.month_yyyy_mm
),
month_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    month_yyyy_mm,
    SUM(CASE WHEN month_balance > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_customer_count,
    AVG(month_balance) AS avg_balance
  FROM customer_month_matrix
  GROUP BY month_yyyy_mm
),
max_pos AS (
  SELECT MAX(positive_customer_count) AS val FROM month_metrics
),
min_pos AS (
  SELECT MIN(positive_customer_count) AS val FROM month_metrics
),
max_month AS (
  SELECT month_yyyy_mm, positive_customer_count, avg_balance

  SELECT month_yyyy_mm, positive_customer_count, avg_balance

  max_month.positive_customer_count AS max_month_positive_customer_count,

rows.question: For each customer, group all deposits and withdrawals by the first day of each month to obtain a monthly net amount, then calculate each month’s closing balance by cumulatively summing these monthly nets. Next, determine the most recent month’s growth rate by comparing its closing balance to the prior month’s balance, treating deposits as positive and withdrawals as negative, and if the previous month’s balance is zero, the growth rate should be the current month’s balance multiplied by 100. Finally, compute the percentage of customers whose most recent month shows a growth rate of more than 5%.

WITH customer_txn_monthly_net AS (
SELECT
  customer_id,
  date(substr(txn_date,1,4) || '-' || printf('%02d', CAST(strftime('%m', txn_date) AS INTEGER)) || '-01') as month_start_date,
  CAST(strftime('%Y', txn_date) AS INTEGER) AS year,
  CAST(strftime('%m', txn_date) AS INTEGER) AS month,
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN lower(txn_type) = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount
      WHEN lower(txn_type) = 'withdrawal' THEN -txn_amount
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) AS monthly_net
FROM customer_transactions
WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL
  AND txn_date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY customer_id, year, month, month_start_date
),
customer_monthly_closing_balance_59 AS (
SELECT
  cmn.customer_id,
  cmn.month_start_date,
  cmn.year,
  cmn.month,
  cmn.monthly_net,
  SUM(cmn.monthly_net) OVER (
    PARTITION BY cmn.customer_id
    ORDER BY cmn.year, cmn.month
    ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
  ) AS closing_balance
FROM customer_txn_monthly_net cmn
),
customer_most_recent_two_months_balance AS (
SELECT
  c.customer_id,
  mc.month_start_date AS most_recent_month_start,
  mc.closing_balance AS most_recent_closing_balance,
  pmc.month_start_date AS prior_month_start,
  pmc.closing_balance AS prior_month_closing_balance
FROM (
  SELECT customer_id,
         month_start_date,
         closing_balance,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month_start_date DESC) AS rn
  FROM customer_monthly_closing_balance_59
  WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL
) mc
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT customer_id,
         month_start_date,
         closing_balance,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month_start_date DESC) AS rn
  FROM customer_monthly_closing_balance_59
  WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL
) pmc
  ON mc.customer_id = pmc.customer_id
 AND mc.rn = 1
 AND pmc.rn = 2
JOIN (
  SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM customer_monthly_closing_balance_59 WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL
) c
  ON c.customer_id = mc.customer_id
WHERE mc.rn = 1

  COUNT(*) AS total_customers_considered,
  SUM(CASE
        WHEN prior_month_closing_balance IS NULL OR prior_month_closing_balance = 0
          THEN CASE WHEN (most_recent_closing_balance * 100) > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
        ELSE CASE WHEN ((most_recent_closing_balance / prior_month_closing_balance) - 1) > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

rows.question: For each month, calculate the total balance from all users for the previous month (measured as of the 1st of each month), replacing any negative balances with zero. Ensure that data from the first month is used only as a baseline for calculating previous total balance, and exclude it from the final output. Sort the results in ascending order by month.

WITH transaction_months_present AS (
SELECT
  printf('%04d-%02d-01',
    CAST(substr(txn_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER),
    CAST(substr(txn_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER)
  ) AS month_start
FROM customer_transactions
WHERE txn_date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY month_start
),
customer_monthly_balance_snapshot AS (
SELECT
  ct.customer_id AS customer_id,
  -- month_start as first day of the month in ISO 'YYYY-MM-01'
  substr(ct.txn_date, 1, 7) || '-01' AS month_start,
  -- balance as of month_start: sum of prior transactions (txn_date < month_start)
  COALESCE((
    SELECT SUM(txn_amount)
    FROM customer_transactions AS t2
    WHERE t2.customer_id = ct.customer_id
      AND t2.txn_date < (substr(ct.txn_date,1,7) || '-01')
  ), 0) AS balance_as_of_month_start
FROM customer_transactions AS ct
GROUP BY ct.customer_id, month_start
),
customer_transaction_rows AS (
SELECT
  customer_id,
  -- normalize txn_date to ISO YYYY-MM-DD where possible; assume input is already ISO or YYYY-MM-DD-like
  -- SQLite's date() will return NULL for unparsable values; keep original string if date() fails using COALESCE
  COALESCE(date(txn_date), txn_date) AS txn_date,
  CAST(txn_amount AS NUMERIC) AS txn_amount
FROM customer_transactions
)
SELECT
  m.month_start,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(SUM(s.balance_as_of_month_start), 0) < 0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(s.balance_as_of_month_start) END AS total_balance
FROM transaction_months_present m
LEFT JOIN customer_monthly_balance_snapshot s
  ON s.month_start = m.month_start
WHERE m.month_start > (SELECT MIN(month_start) FROM transaction_months_present)
GROUP BY m.month_start
ORDER BY m.month_start ASC
